name: Would you like to run an idol café? 2
source: Hoping to save the café he works at from being closed, Naoya enlists the help of his cute maid co-workers, Ichigo, Kuu, Mayuki. The three girls form an idol unit, Sweet Shoreline, to popularize The Seaside Café - but becoming an idol isn't that easy!
translation: 为了避免他工作的咖啡馆被关门，直哉向他可爱的女仆同事一护、小空和麻由雪寻求帮助。三个女孩组成了一个偶像组合“Sweet Shoreline”，以推广海边咖啡馆 - 但成为一名偶像并不那么容易！
